# The first week after the new site goes live

*Kernel · from the Launching a page process in Knowledge and the Launch plan board*

## Before launch day

- [ ] WEB-3's two About-page links fixed (they still point at the old address).
- [ ] Redirects from the old addresses in place (WEB-6), so old bookmarks land on the matching new page.
- [ ] One person names who answers the contact form during launch week.

## Launch day

Publish on a weekday morning, as the *Launching a page* process says, so clients can reply the same day.

- [ ] Publish before 10am.
- [ ] Open every page on a phone and on a laptop.
- [ ] Send the address to the three clients in the case studies first.

## Each morning that week

- [ ] Run the link check (Reviewer's weekly routine can run daily this week).
- [ ] Look at the contact form's messages and answer within the day.
- [ ] Note anything a client says about the site in WEB-8, the launch epic.

## End of the week

- [ ] Ask two clients to try the contact form and tell us how it went.
- [ ] Decide whether the old site can be switched off, once the redirects have had a week.
- [ ] Ten-minute review with Priya: what to fix, what to leave.

Each item can become a task on the Launch plan board when you're ready; nothing here has been started.
